title: Use a ComfyUI workflow that leverages an LLM to turn a simple idea into a…
content:
Use a ComfyUI workflow that leverages an LLM to turn a simple idea into a storyboard by structuring prompts into storyboard-ready scenes that define the video’s progression.  
Pair the generated storyboard with reference images, then send it directly into Seedance 2.0 to generate the video.

Empareja el guion gráfico generado con imágenes de referencia, luego envíalo directamente a Seedance 2.0 para generar el video.
